title: Task-Phase-Conditioned Expert Routing Is Not a Reliable Proxy for Quantization Sensitivity in MoE FFN Tensors
abstract: arXiv:2610.20826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate whether per-layer, per-task-phase (prompt/reasoning/response) expert-routing statistics in a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model can guide layer-wise mixed-precision quantization of routed-expert FFN tensors (down/gate and up). To attain layerwise routing statistics, we build a routing-capture and profiling pipeline for Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B in ik_llama.cpp, derive a composite sensitivity score from routing entropy/decisiveness, coefficient of variation (CV), Jaccard/phase-fragility, and top-1 expert strength, and use coordinate descent to tune a layer allocation that respects a fixed average bits-per-weight budget. Notably, the profiling pipeline is applicable to standard top-k MoE architectures. Across independent experimental conditions (about 4.0 bpw flat, about 2.7 bpw steep, and about 2.7 bpw random allocation as a control), reallocation fails to outperform the uniform baseline within each quality tier. translated_title: 任务阶段条件化的专家路由并非MoE FFN张量量化敏感性的可靠代理指标
translated_abstract: 我们研究了混合专家语言模型中按层、按任务阶段（提示/推理/响应）的专家路由统计信息，是否能够指导对路由专家FFN张量（down/gate与up）进行逐层混合精度量化。为了获取逐层路由统计信息，我们为ik_llama.cpp中的Qwen-3.6-35B-A3B构建了一个路由捕获与分析流水线，从路由熵/决断性、变异系数（CV）、Jaccard相似度/阶段脆弱性以及top-1专家强度中推导出一个复合敏感性评分，并使用坐标下降法来调整层分配方案，以满足固定的平均每权重比特数预算。值得注意的是，该分析流水线适用于标准的top-k MoE架构。在多个独立实验条件下（约4.0 bpw平坦分配、约2.7 bpw陡峭分配，以及作为对照的约2.7 bpw随机分配），重新分配方案在每个质量层级内均未能超越均匀分配基线。在平坦重新分配……
tldr: 研究发现，基于任务阶段的专家路由统计信息作为MoE模型FFN张量量化敏感性的代理指标并不可靠——由复合敏感性评分指导的逐层混合精度量化重分配在多种实验条件下均未能超越均匀分配基线。
en_tdlr: Task-phase-conditioned expert routing statistics are not a reliable proxy for quantization sensitivity in MoE FFN tensors—routing-based mixed-precision reallocation guided by composite sensitivity scores fails to outperform uniform allocation baselines across multiple experimental conditions.
